subject.title: feat(sdk): always persist media facts and ship facts-first replacements for legacy Media* surfaces

question: Should OpenClaw publicly commit to `media-local-roots`, the five `Attachment*` template variables, and the 2026-10-01 retirement schedule for the legacy `Media*` projection?
rationale: This is a durable plugin SDK, configuration-template, and persisted-transcript compatibility decision; implementation review cannot determine whether the new public surface and retirement date match maintainer product commitments.

options.title: Approve the staged facts-first contract
options.body: Confirm the new public replacements and dated migration window after checking the known external consumers and the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Keep the bridge without a removal date
options.body: Ship facts-first replacements but leave the legacy projection ineligible for removal until maintainers have completed the external-consumer audit.

options.title: Narrow the public surface
options.body: Retain canonical persistence internally while deferring any SDK or template exports that do not yet have a confirmed external use case.

recommendation.title: Approve the staged facts-first contract
recommendation.body: Confirm the new public replacements and dated migration window after checking the known external consumers and the upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged media-facts work and this PR’s compatibility record make this contributor the clearest available routing candidate for the migration design.
